notes.summary: The false extended-valued flattening lemma remains excluded. Direct single-net and actual-ample arguments repair the fixed-divisor cone; divided FS quotients need not decrease.
notes.detailedSummary: On arbitrary-cardinality algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero fields, the reconstruction uses only one defining numerical FS net and the actual-ample G0 grant. It proves rational rounding within that net, an embedding into a fixed actual ample bundle, finite-polytope homogeneous projection, raywise homogeneous decomposition, literal divisor division and ample-compactness convergence of nonmonotone quotients. On smooth projective Y with actual B=A+D it obtains {v numerical B-psh: v<=sigma_D+C for some C}=sigma_D+PSH(Y,A) at all analytic points. This repairs cone foundations only; it does not establish the new local operator.
notes.text:
The mathematical proof draft is in P16.2-paper.md, Sections 2 and 5, also rendered as P16.2-paper.tex and P16.2-paper.pdf. Rerun all preservation, diagnostics and document builds with python3 rerun.py. Primary literal units and exact scope restrictions are in external-premises.json and evidence/units-index.json.

Counterexample proof: let K be an isolated q plus p_j converging to p_infinity. F_a consists of f(q)=c, f(p_a)=-infinity and f=c-m elsewhere, m positive integer. These extended-continuous families are stable under constants. For each fixed a the net m increasing gives g(q)=0 and g=-infinity elsewhere, so g lies in each limiting family of parameter 1/a. A decreasing original-family net cannot change its label after any term from F_a: later values at p_a must stay -infinity, which only F_a permits. Its parameters therefore cannot tend to zero. This disproves the general BJ Lemma 4.6, not an equation theorem. Strict shifts at a common pole and the associated strictly negative exponential difference are invalid.

Safe fixed-A flattening uses finite continuous inner FS functions. A small positive shift below two finite upper functions remains strictly smaller even at a limiting pole; compactness of the negative open sets provides a common inner index. This is done before adding sigma_D. Rational coefficient rounding within a single original net instead uses non-strict inequalities phi_i<=f_i,delta<=phi_i+delta and g_i,delta=f_i,delta+delta. Choose 2delta_new<=min(delta_old) to get a directed decreasing g-net without any strict pole argument.

For rational coefficients lambda_j with max lambda_j>=0, the homogeneous projection has the formula inf_{r>=0} max_j(x_j+r lambda_j) = max_{vertices w of {w>=0,sum w=1,w.lambda>=0}} sum w_j x_j. The vertices are nonnegative-slope unit vectors and rational zero-slope two-branch mixtures. Breakpoint convexity proves the formula; replacing -infinity entries by finite floors and commuting infima handles every base-locus point. Clearing denominators gives actual section monomials in the same bundle. One-dimensional supporting lines then reconstruct every genuine potential from its homogeneous components.

For homogeneous h<=sigma_D, compactness of {sigma_D=-1} yields FS approximants h_i<=t_i sigma_D with t_i increasing to 1. Prime-divisor orders allow actual global section division by s_(degree*t_i D), using normality. The quotients are realized after arbitrarily small numerical corrections in a fixed actual ample A cone. Normalized ample compactness, followed by divisorial determination in a common ample cone, gives h=sigma_D+r at every point. Homogeneous decomposition and ample envelopes give the entire reference-dominated cone. No varying-class nested closure is invoked. On P1, h_i=(1-i^-2)sigma decreases, but subtracting t_i sigma, t_i=1-i^-1, gives (i^-1-i^-2)sigma, increasing wherever sigma<0. Thus quotient monotonicity is explicitly not assumed.

The exact-arithmetic diagnostic output diagnostics-output.json matches 5,616 three-branch cases with slopes {-1,0,1}, values {-2,-1,0,1,2,-infinity}. This finite grid supports checking the implementation, not the mathematical generalization. All claims are unverified proof drafts relative to the actual-ample grant.

notes.summary: Retained polar data and genuine original-section metrics are reconstructed for every smooth integral proper carrier and every actual big rational L, with whole bad-fiber saturation and arbitrary field cardinality.
notes.detailedSummary: The argument first obtains smooth projective Y by Chow and the exact characteristic-zero Temkin theorem, proves actual section descent over normal X, and constructs a big original Cartier bundle. For any specified big L, a hyperplane restriction growth argument gives pi*L=A+D. Every bad geometric fiber is wholly inside D because its positive-dimensional components carry an antiample restriction. P=pi|D| is saturated, and Y minus D is isomorphic to X minus P. Canonical original metrics are constructed using compatible valuative centers; sigma_D+psi descends all-point, including -infinity poles. Multiplication by the actual divisor section converts one finite fixed-A FS net into an actual decreasing original-L section net. The reference-dominated original section cone is therefore bijective and divisorially homeomorphic to the genuine ample cone. Its compactness and finite energy are constructed without projectivity of the original carrier.
notes.text:
P16.2-paper.md Sections 3--6 contain the complete draft arguments, with source scopes and literal evidence in external-premises.json. TeX and PDF versions have the same problem ID; rerun with python3 rerun.py.

Fix any algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero k, of arbitrary cardinality, and any smooth integral proper X of dimension n>0. Chow gives an integral projective birational refinement. Temkin v2 Theorem 1.2.1 applies because it is Noetherian quasi-excellent generically reduced and over Spec Q; finite type over Q is not required. Its finite blowup sequence remains integral and projective, and the regular final Y is smooth over perfect k. The normal-base theorem gives pi_*O_Y=O_X and literal H0(Y,p pi*L)=H0(X,pL). A very ample hyperplane H on Y avoiding the finite exceptional primes pushes to an effective Cartier B on smooth X; pi*B=H+E with effective exceptional E, and multiplication by s_E injects the positive degree-n section growth of H into that of B. Thus big actual original bundles exist.

For any chosen big rational L, let F=q pi*L integral. A very ample hyperplane T on Y need not be reduced: on T choose ample N with N-F|T globally generated and a section avoiding all associated points. Its powers inject F^m|T into N^m. Serre vanishing and the coherent Euler polynomial give h0(T,F^m|T)=O(m^(n-1)). Hence positive limsup degree-n growth of F supplies a section of mF-M for a very ample M, yielding pi*L=A+D with A=M/(qm), D effective rational. The datum retains the actual isomorphism, and its raw mass is A^n; no choice independence or unrestricted minimal-class volume is claimed.

On a bad geometric fiber, the normal-base quasi-finite birational theorem excludes zero-dimensional components. On every integral reduced component pi*L is trivial, so D restricts to -A. A nonzero antiample section would inject unbounded ample section growth into H0(O), impossible. Thus all components, and the whole bad fiber, lie in |D|. With P=pi(|D|), pi^-1(P)=|D| and Y minus |D| is isomorphic to X minus P. This uses saturation of entire fibers, not just exceptional divisors.

Proper valuation-ring centers and their uniqueness give compatible canonical trivial metrics on all actual original bundles. Compactness is proved using a finite affine center-domain cover and Tychonoff, without metrizability. Analytic surjectivity and compact-to-Hausdorff closed quotient descent show that sigma_D+psi, for genuine A-psh psi, descends to an actual usc metric u. On P its value is -infinity, and elsewhere the fiber is singleton. Clear all degrees in a finite fixed-A approximating net, multiply every section by s_(pD), and use literal section descent. This produces actual original section maxima u_alpha decreasing to u at every analytic point, including the common poles. With tau=F(0), n1 gives {original section-psh u: u<=tau+C}=F(PSH(Y,A)). Divisorial order cancellation and ample determination give a genuine quotient, normalized compactness and E_M(u)=E_A(Q(u)).

The classical Miyake--Oda fan is checked as a test over every retained field, not as a domain restriction: its ten maximal charts are unimodular A3 charts, the complete-fan DVR proof gives properness, and the three wall degrees a1+a6-a2-a5, a2+a7-a3-a6, a3+a5-a1-a7 sum to zero. No ample original bundle can have positive degree on all three proper curves. The small determinant and coefficient checks are diagnostics only. Genuine local MA identification is not a conclusion of this geometric and cone reconstruction.

notes.summary: A pretarget pairing has raw mass A^n, intrinsic target integrability and an attained unique equation with all original continuous variations. P16.2 remains incomplete: the local contact/collar bridge for bounded discontinuous and finite-energy products is unproved.
notes.detailedSummary: Before any target, the retained genuine quotient gives positive mixed Radon pairings p_*M_A. A reconstructed capacity estimate supplies an actual E1 pole on all D, proving zero exceptional mass and target exclusion. Fiber-max relative potentials q_u are actual original usc functions; their dual energy is finite exactly when every finite-energy q_u is integrable. Unique zero-exceptional Radon inversion identifies this with the ample target class and gives actual attainment, comparison and uniqueness modulo constants. Minorant and all-original-continuous-majorant energies agree, and their two-sided derivative includes every f in C(Xan). Divided global-section local products converge even to bounded discontinuous floors, and their relative-floor mixed nonpluripolar and weighted limits recover the pairing. This does not yet identify the full required local contact/collar construction. The exact remaining statement L is recorded, and candidate is false.
notes.text:
The deliverable is the standalone P16.2-paper.md, P16.2-paper.tex and P16.2-paper.pdf, with status.json, external-premises.json, 18 preserved supplied blocks, 124 literal primary units, and retained new public responses. Run python3 rerun.py. Exact argv, environment versions, stdout/stderr and artifact hashes are retained; document compilation and finite diagnostics are not mathematical certification.

In the notation and domain of n2, let Q(u) be the genuine A quotient. Define the pretarget symmetric pairing as p_*M_A(Q(u1),...,Q(un)); it is positive Radon of exact raw mass V=A^n before any target is selected. To prove zero mass on D, take a normalized A-section logarithm a vanishing along D and w=1-(1-a)^(1/(n+2)). Convex slopes in [0,1] and ample envelopes give genuine membership. Signed integration by parts proves Cap{a<=-s}<=n/s. For bounded floors z_s, strict locality, fixed masses and mixed positivity give J(z_s)<=1+integral_1^infinity t^n Cap{z<=-t}dt. The factor t^n is essential. For w its integrand is O(t^-2), so w is genuinely E1 and is -infinity on all D. Every ample mixed E1 product integrates w, hence gives D zero mass.

Define q_u(x)=max_{p(y)=x} Q(u)(y), attained on the compact fiber, with upper semicontinuity proved by closed images of superlevel sets. Off P it equals u-tau; on P it is a canonical retained relative value, never -infinity-(-infinity). For mass-V Radon mu set D_M(mu)=sup_{u in E1_M}(E_M(u)-integral q_u dmu). Finiteness forces every q_u integrable, and q_F(w) excludes P. The positive-functional construction integral g(jx)dmu on X minus P, followed by Riesz, gives the unique Radon inverse nu with zero D mass; compact bump functions prove that assertion and weak lifting continuity. D_M(mu)=E_A^vee(nu). By G0 it is finite iff every finite-energy q_u is integrable. No imposed skeletal support or arbitrary fiber selection occurs.

For all original f in C(Xan), cancel finite sigma at divisorial function-field points and apply actual-ample usc determination to obtain F(eta)<=u+t f iff eta<=Q(u)+t p*f. The genuine-minorant energy is E_A(P_A(Q(u)+t p*f)). The infimum over ALL original continuous relative majorants q_u+t f<=b is identical: decreasing all b, compact ample envelopes and singleton divisorial fibers determine the same limit. Thus both derivative signs give the raw integral of f against the pairing. Ample attainment and the actual section map give an attained original finite-energy maximizer; both derivative signs give its pairing equation. Zero-exceptional Radon inversion and G0 give uniqueness modulo one constant, and comparison transports on strict sets outside P. These are actual pairing results, conditional as a genuine P16.2 local Monge--Ampere theory.

Local progress: in a frame off P, the literal raw weight is lambda=psi+h_A+log|f_D|, with a PLUS unit logarithm. Finite actual original-section products agree with the finite ample products by continuous local intersection theory. For finite fixed-A nets decreasing globally to bounded genuine psi, G0 gives convergence on compact original frame neighborhoods even for discontinuous endpoints. It gives germ independence in this divided global-section category, and finite-stage analytic-unit frame identities pass through its decreasing limits. The relative floors max(u,tau-j), not absolute original floors, correspond to max(psi,-j). Mixed locality and E1 integrability recover their unbounded nonpluripolar restrictions and weighted limits with mass V.

Exact unresolved lemma L: prove that the local rational contact approximants and actual ample collars of the required original local intersection construction, on compact original frame neighborhoods off P, give these same bounded, possibly discontinuous products independently of contact nets, collar realizations and compatible frames; include their integrable weighted limits and identify their relative-floor finite-energy nonpluripolar extension. The missing step is product comparison with the actual ample local construction. Division by s_D maps the original frame e_L to the actual A frame e_A/f_D, isometrically. A direct audit in that frame could avoid globalization of local contact families, which need not be globally decreasing fixed-A nets. Neither route is completed here. A continuous uniform-convergence theorem does not prove this. The primary collar identity must retain Phi=p+Psi/a and lambda=a Phi+a h0+M+1; omission of p or a zero-branch maximum asserted negative is invalid. No stronger arbitrary-local-psh or retained-choice-independence theorem is introduced as a gate. No counterexample to L or P16.2 is claimed. The exact original task remains unproved; candidate=false.
